relevance.rationale: A Composition-Diamond lemma for the free partial algebra kC(X) on a free category over an oriented multigraph (Thm 4.4), plus Groebner-Shirshov bases for the simplicial category (Thm 5.1) and the cyclic category (Thm 5.4), with Cor. 5.2/5.3 reproving Mac Lane VIII.5.1/5.2. Everything new is the MULTI-OBJECT ('monoid with several objects') generalisation. The folio's Groebner-Shirshov machinery is entirely single-object associative: H_n(q) normal forms (UGB/GrobnerShirshov/HeckeGS.lean, def:hecke-normal-form), U_q(su(2)) q-Serre rewriting, transfer-matrix and MBA GS reduction, KS finiteness via Bergman's diamond lemma. The paper's own Remark after Thm 4.4 states that the one-object case 'is exact Composition-Diamond lemma for free associative algebras' -- exactly what the folio already cites via bokutchen2014 (8 sites) and bokut2005 (5 sites) -- and its Sec. 2 survey is a shorter version of bokutchen2014's. Corpus-grep: 'cyclic category', 'path algebra', 'partial algebra', 'Composition-Diamond' all 0 hits in content/; 'quiver' only in unrelated DT/BPS and glossary prose. Full-text scan of the document: Temperley-Lieb 0, Hecke 0, Catalan 0, Young 0, Jones 0; 'braid' (4) and 'Markov' (1) occur only as bibliography pointers to other papers by the same authors, not as results proved here. Closest hook, checked and rejected: def:ccg-cosimplicial-identities defers 'the deeper categorical identities (delta^j . delta^i = delta^i . delta^(j-1) for i < j)', and Thm 5.1's relation family is exactly that identity with Cor. 5.2 giving the unique canonical form; but that block's stated obstruction is a Lean dependent-typing scope limit ('would require richer types for the face maps'), not a missing mathematical statement, and maclane1971 is already in references.ts as the natural source for the presentation this document reproves. Scope-(a) negative: as read, it supplies nothing this folio can consume -- not a claim that categorical Groebner-Shirshov methods are irrelevant in principle. Revisit if the folio ever formalises a GS basis over a genuinely multi-object structure (the brane-tower crossed groupoid, or a Temperley-Lieb/tangle category rather than the TL_n algebras).

proposedActions.rationale: def:groebner-basis and the whole UGB GrobnerShirshov cluster work over free associative algebras (one object). Thm 4.4's one-object specialisation is, by the document's own Remark, the classical associative CD-lemma already sourced at 13 sites via bokutchen2014 and bokut2005, so registering this preprint would add a bibliography entry with no load-bearing citation site.

Checked as the one specific hook: Thm 5.1's coface relation and Cor. 5.2's canonical form are literally the deferred cosimplicial identities and normal form for the simplicial category. Rejected because the deferral there is a Lean dependent-typing scope limit, not an unsourced mathematical claim, and maclane1971 (already in references.ts) is the presentation this document reproves. Reopen only if a Lean formalisation of the simplicial normal form is attempted, where a confluent rewriting system would be worth more than a presentation.
